title: Announce gradient destination uses legacy ULA/native derivation, not AddrForKey
description: lichen-node/src/announce.rs:230-232 builds gradient destination as self.prefix ++ iid. Production constructs AnnounceProcessor with prefix = dodag_id[..8] (a 02xx root prefix) at rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1055-1058, so the destination is a routable-space 02xx address embedding the IID — the rejected LICHEN-native derivation, not upstream AddrForKey(originator). The originator's pubkey is available in the announce, so the destination should be ygg_addr_from_pubkey(originator_pubkey). Corollary: the full-address gradient lookup (rpl_stack/mod.rs:275-279) can never match a correctly-derived 02xx destination. Tests use ULA fd00:: (announce.rs tests) so they pass; production is wrong. Related: gradient.rs:178 lookup_by_iid matches destination[8..]==iid which holds only because announce.rs builds it that way. Verify cargo test -p lichen-node + gateway gradient tests green.
